scripts.test: npm run clean:results && allure run -- playwright test
scripts.test:web-desktop: npm run clean:results && allure run -- playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:web-mobile: npm run clean:results && allure run -- playwright test --project='Mobile Chrome'
scripts.test:mobile: npm run clean:results && rm -rf test-results/maestro; mkdir -p test-results/maestro allure-results; maestro test tests/maestro --format junit --output test-results/maestro/junit.xml --debug-output test-results/maestro --flatten-debug-output; r=$?; node scripts/maestro/junit-to-allure.mjs test-results/maestro/junit.xml test-results/maestro allure-results; allure generate allure-results; exit $r
scripts.test:all: npm run clean:results && playwright test; p=$?; rm -rf test-results/maestro; mkdir -p test-results/maestro allure-results; maestro test tests/maestro --format junit --output test-results/maestro/junit.xml --debug-output test-results/maestro --flatten-debug-output; m=$?; node scripts/maestro/junit-to-allure.mjs test-results/maestro/junit.xml test-results/maestro allure-results; allure generate allure-results; exit $((p || m))
scripts.test:human: npm run clean:results && allure run -- playwright test -c playwright.human.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run clean:results && allure run -- playwright test tests/playwright/e2e
scripts.test:api: npm run clean:results && allure run -- playwright test tests/playwright/api
scripts.quality:check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build
